name: Birdie's Quick Fix Pack
flavorText: "Get up, we're out of body bags."

talent.name: Combat Medic
talent.desc:
+80% Revive Speed
-50% Weakened Debuff timer
Provides +50% Damage Resistance to both agents while reviving or being revived, and for 10s after a successful revive.
Successful revives provide +1 Skill Tier for 5s. Revives at Skill Tier 6 grant Overcharge for 15s.

name: Harrier Pride
flavorText: "Where Eagles score!"

talent.name: Rebalance
talent.desc:
Getting kills and hitting enemies 300% times builds Red stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Weapon Damage.

Getting hit 300% times builds Blue stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Damage Resistance.

Upon reaching 80 stacks in total, lose all stacks and receive a separate bonus of 0.5% Damage Resistance per Red stack and 0.5% Weapon Damage per Blue stack until the next time the stack cap is reached.

name: Memento
flavorText:
"I took from those who watched, hunted, and collected, until only their shadows remained. Now my watch has ended, so yours may begin."

- Inscription by an unknown author

talent.name: Kill Confirmed
talent.desc: Enemies you kill drop a trophy on death. Collecting trophies provides both a short and long term buff, the first of which scales with the number of core attributes equipped, and lasts 10s. - +5% Weapon Damage - +10% Bonus Armor - +5% Skill Efficiency For every trophy collected, gain an additional +1% weapon damage, +1% skill efficiency, and +0.1% armor regeneration for 300s. Maximum 30 stacks.

name: Ninja Bike Messenger Bag
flavorText: "From the depths of hell, this has been resurrected as if it cannot die." The Priest

talent.name: Versatile
talent.desc: Slots in with any equipped Gear Set and or Brand Set item to fulfill a requirement towards unlocking a Gear Sets bonus. Can unlock bonuses from multiple sets simultaneously.

name: Beacon
flavorText: With me.

talent.name: Bond
talent.desc:
Both you and Allies receive +30% Critical Hit Damage, +15% Skill Efficiency and +2% Armor Regen when an Ally is within 10m of you.

Receive +15% Critical Hit Damage, +7.5% Skill Efficiency and +1% Armor Regen when one of your Skills is within 10m of you.

Only the highest group of buffs can be active at one time.

name: Collector
flavorText:
"Let's see the Division glue you back together after this."
- The Strategist

talent.name: Hoarder
talent.desc:
+300% Grenade Capacity
+50% Grenade Radius
+35% Grenade Damage
+25% Grenade Damage for each extra enemy caught in the blast

name: Provocator
flavorText: "One does not simply wear red into battle. A red knight is not afraid but ready to provoke ." - Anonymous

talent.name: Challenger
talent.desc: Receive +25% Damage Resistence from enemies within 20m.

name: Ridgeway's Pride
flavorText:
"You can tell a lot about a man by the way he bleeds. Me? I bleed for my country, and nothing else."

- General Antwon Ridgeway

talent.name: Bleeding Edge
talent.desc:
Shooting enemies within 15m applies bleed to the target.

Repair 3%-48% of your armor per second for every enemy that is bleeding within 15m.

Repair strength per number of bleeding enemies:

1:3% 2:6% 3:12% 4:24% 5:48%

name: Tardigrade Armor System
flavorText: An evolution of the reactive armor concept, ablative nano-plating was initially designed as a prototype technology for self-repairing heat shields on aircraft repeatedly entering and exiting planetary atmospheres.

talent.name: Ablative Nano-Plating
talent.desc:
Whenever your or any ally's armor breaks, they gain 80% of your armor as bonus armor for 10s.

Cooldown per ally: 45s

Killing an enemy with your specialization weapon removes this cooldown for all allies.

name: BTSU Datagloves
flavorText:
"Pop always told me, 'Son, you're only as good as the tools you work with.' So I chose to work with the organization with the best tools."
 - Galveston

talent.name: Transference Overclock
talent.desc: Detonating a Booster or Artificer Hive refreshes all allies' skill cooldowns and grants them overcharge for 15s. This can occur at most once per 120s.

name: Bloody Knuckles
flavorText: "A broken watch is still a good memento." 13

talent.name: Over the top
talent.desc:
Damaging an enemy with a grenade or striking an enemy with a melee attack activates Seeing Red

Seeing Red grants +25% weapon damage and +100% to melee damage. 

Seeing Red lasts 20 seconds and has a 60 second cooldown after completion.

While in cooldown, damaging  an enemy with a melee attack or hitting an enemy with the effect of a grenade will complete the cooldown instantly.

name: Exodus Gloves
flavorText: "I'd like to make a withdrawal."

talent.name: Smoke Screen
talent.desc:
On Armor break, drop a Smoke Bomb at your feet, concealing you from enemies for 300%s.
Cooldown: 40s

name: Overdogs
flavorText: "Start from the bottom and make your way up."

talent.name: Weakest Link
talent.desc:
Amplifies Weapon Damage by 30% to the lowest ranking enemies within the Tier hierarchy.

Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder

Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator

Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy

name: Rugged Gauntlets
flavorText:
"Can't say I invented this, but at least I had a hand in it."
- Calvin McManus

talent.name: Iron Grip
talent.desc:
-50% Recoil Penalty when hip-firing.
-50% Recoil Penalty when blind-firing from cover.

name: Centurion's Scabbard
flavorText: "It's better to have more than one gun in your holster."

talent.name: Counter
talent.desc:
Swapping weapons will give the following groups of bonuses one by one, in order:

1. +20% Rate of Fire, +20% Weapon Damage
2. +50% Magazine Size, +50% Reload Speed

The bonuses remain active for 12s or until the next weapon swap.
Swapping to your sidearm will not trigger the next group of bonuses.

name: Dodge City Gunslinger’s Holster
flavorText:
"Fast is fine, but accuracy is everything. In a gun fight... You need to take your time in a hurry."

- Wyatt Earp

talent.name: Quick Draw
talent.desc:
While your pistol is holstered, gain a stacking buff every 30%s, up to 100.

When you swap to it, your first shot consumes the buff and deals +10% damage per stack.

name: Imperial Dynasty
flavorText:
"Symbols are important. Look at the phoenix you wear on your sleeve. The dragon bears a similar significance to me."
- Faye Lau

talent.name: Dragon's Glare
talent.desc:
While in combat, applies burn to the enemy closet to you within 20m.

Cooldown: 35s

name: Nimble Holster
flavorText: "Run for your life."

talent.name: Bob and Weave
talent.desc:
Receive repairs of 5% of your Total Armor for every 1m run in cover-to-cover.
Damage taken while doing a cover-to-cover is healed over 10s.

name: Shocker Punch
flavorText: "After getting sucker punched at the mall, I came up with a shocking solution." Anonymous

talent.name: Defibrillator
talent.desc:
While "Shocker Punch" is equipped, the stun received by the agent from the Shock status effect will be reduced by 50%.

Using a shield will give 100% to melee damage.

Using St. Elmo's Engine with the holster will give 100% extra melee dmg and will make the next melee attack to apply Shock to the target.

Using all three items will offer all of the above mentioned bonuses and the Shock from the melee attack will have a 5m radius, starting from the first target.

15 seconds cooldown.

name: Waveform
flavorText: Graphite layers are suffused throughout the holster kevlar weave, that when the wearer moves creates an inductive oscillating electromagnetic field. This field allows for remote charging of electrical devices.

talent.name: Alternating Current
talent.desc: Generate a stack of 2.5% skill damage on one of your skills every second, capping at 10 stacks. After 10 seconds at the cap the stacks transfer to your other skill. The process then repeats ad-infinitum.

name: Acosta's Kneepads
flavorText:
"They got their asses caught by the JTF, but they don't have my mad parkour skills."
- Eva Acosta

talent.name: Escape Plan
talent.desc:
Vaulting grants +10% Movement Speed for 300%s.
After not moving for 5s, receive +20% Movement Speed for 5s.
Being applied a Status Effect grants +10% Movement Speed for 5s.
Max Movement Speed bonus is 20%. The bonuses do not stack with Movement Speed bonuses from other sources.
-50% Movement Impairment penalty from Status Effects.

name: NinjaBike Messenger Kneepads
flavorText:
"Parkour! Parkour!"
- an over-enthusiastic NinjaBike messenger

talent.name: Parkour!
talent.desc: Performing a cover to cover or vaulting reloads your drawn weapon.

name: Nurse's Kneepads
flavorText: Sit still.

talent.name: Impervious
talent.desc: Both you and Allies within 10m of you receive +40% Hazard Protection.

name: Catharsis
flavorText:
"The establishment does everything in its power to ensure that revolutionary rage is redirected into empty outlets which provide pressure releases for desires that could become dangerous if allowed to progress."

- George L. Jackson

talent.name: Vicious Cycle
talent.desc: Taking damage builds stacks to a cap of 30. Each stack grants 1.5% Weapon Damage. Taking damage at max stacks triggers a purge, removing all stacks and Status Effects and then dropping a healing cloud which restores 5% of Max Armor for 10s to all allies in the cloud.

name: Coyote’s Mask
flavorText:
"Lived through this bullet. I'll live through yours."
- Coyote

talent.name: Pack Instincts
talent.desc:
You and all allies gain a bonus based on the distance of the last enemy you hit.

0-15m: +25% critical hit damage
15-25m: +10% critical hit damage and +10% critical hit chance
25m+: +25% critical hit chance

name: The Catalyst
flavorText: "We're still being tested. The only constant variable is fire."

talent.name: Chemical Agent
talent.desc:
Catalysis
Dealing and receiving status effects (Burn, Bleed, Shock, EMP/Disrupt, Poison, and Blind/Disorient) builds stacks of Catalysis to a maximum of 12. Each stack grants:
    +2% weapon damage
    +2% status effects

Each enemy within 25 meters that is affected by a status effect grants +100% stack/sec. Being affected by status effects grants +200% stacks/sec.
Stacks decay at 100% stack/sec after 5s if no enemies in the radius or you are affected by status effects.

Reactant
At max stacks, killing a status-affected enemy grants bonuses for 5s:
    +25% bonus armor
    +20% reload speed

Stabilizer
While burning, you can maintain ADS without disruption.

name: Tinkerer
flavorText: "Why not both?"

talent.name: Abridged
talent.desc:
If your Primary and Secondary weapons are not Exotic or Named and of the same type, the Secondary Weapon's talent will also be applied to the Primary Weapon.
Does not apply to Talents that include weapon swapping,

name: Vile
flavorText:
"You cling to life like a rebellious teen resisting curfew. But death is patient... and so am I."

- Dr. Vilis, BTSU Physician

talent.name: Toxic Delivery
talent.desc:
Status effects also apply a damage over time debuff for 10s.

Total damage dealt is equal to 50% of your concussion grenade damage and increased by your status effect attributes.
